Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour to $10 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–30 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT - OPERATIONS, FINANCE AND MARKETING SUPPORT
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT - OPERATIONS, FINANCE AND MARKETING SUPPORT



We are a small, growing IT services company based in Auckland, New Zealand. We are looking for a reliable and highly organised Virtual Assistant who can take ownership of recurring administrative work and help keep the business running smoothly.



This is not a technical IT support role. The focus is administration, customer communication, finance support, research, reporting and marketing.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Executive and Administrative Support

- Organise and triage
 inboxes

- Identify messages requiring a decision or follow-up

- Draft routine
s and responses

- Manage calendars and coordinate meetings

- Take overflow phone calls and record accurate messages

- Prepare concise weekly briefings covering outstanding actions, decisions and risks

- Track commitments from
s, calls and meetings



Customer and Sales Support

- Conduct routine customer check-ins

- Record customer feedback, concerns and upcoming requirements

- Maintain prospect, referral and follow-up lists

- Conduct targeted outreach through social media and

- Follow up on quotes, proposals and inactive opportunities

- Gather customer reviews and testimonials



Marketing and Research

- Draft social media posts and other marketing content

- Maintain a content calendar

- Repurpose existing content into posts, newsletters and website material

- Monitor competitors, their services, positioning and marketing

- Prepare daily summaries of relevant AI, technology and industry developments

- Coordinate approved website updates and customer communications



Finance and Supplier Administration

- Reconcile transactions in accounting software

- Chase missing receipts and supporting documents

- Follow up overdue customer invoices

- Prepare supplier invoices and payment information for approval

- Reconcile software supplier invoices against customer billing records

- Identify and report pricing, quantity or billing discrepancies

- Maintain supplier, purchasing, delivery and renewal records



Reporting and Documentation

- Prepare recurring customer reports using information supplied by the team

- Chase missing reporting information and maintain report templates

- Review customer documentation for completeness and flag missing information

- Maintain customer, vendor, warranty and renewal records

- Prepare procedure drafts, checklists and templates from notes or recordings

- Organise contracts, onboarding packs, proposals and company documents



REQUIRED SKILLS



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organisation and attention to detail

- Reliable follow-through without constant reminders

- Comfortable taking ownership of recurring responsibilities

- Experience with
, spreadsheets, cloud storage and online communication tools

- Comfortable using AI tools for research, drafting and summarisation

- Able to communicate professionally with customers and suppliers

- Able to identify discrepancies and ask questions rather than guessing

- Careful with confidential company and customer information

- Stable internet connection and a quiet, suitable environment for business calls



Experience supporting an IT company, professional services business or small business owner would be useful but is not required.



WORKING HOURS AND STYLE



This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm New Zealand time.



New Zealand operates at GMT+13 during daylight saving and GMT+12 during standard time. You must be able to work these hours consistently throughout the year.



We are looking for someone proactive who keeps clear records, follows work through to completion and communicates early when something is unclear or blocked.



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



- Administrative work is completed accurately and on time

- Important follow-ups are not forgotten

- Records and reporting remain current

- Problems and discrepancies are identified early

- The business owner only needs to handle decisions, approvals and exceptions



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction VIDEO explaining why you are suitable for this role

2. Your experience with administration, customer communication, and marketing

3. The software and AI tools you have used

4. Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm New Zealand time

5. An example of a recurring process you have managed without needing regular reminders



Please begin your application with the words “Auckland VA” so we know you have read the full advertisement.

title: Image Data Annotation
description:
We're building an image editing product and need detail-oriented reviewers to check the quality of image cutouts and edits. You'll use a simple web tool (we provide it, nothing to install) to look at images and mark the quality of the result. It's visual work that rewards a sharp eye and consistency.



What you'll do

- You will review transparent "cutout" images and mark them as good, bad, or needs-fixing (e.g. rough edges, leftover background, holes in the subject, cut-off parts).

- Review before/after pairs and judge whether the operation is correct, partial, or wrong.

- Repair the operation using a erase and restore brush.

- Add short tags/notes where prompted. Keep a steady, accurate pace across long sessions.



Requirements

- A good eye for visual detail (edges, fine hair/fur, fringing, transparency).

- Reliable computer + stable internet; comfortable working in a web browser.

- Basic written English (to read short instructions and leave brief notes).

- Consistency and honesty. Quality is checked automatically against known-answer items mixed into the queue.



Nice to have

- Prior data-annotation, QA, or photo-editing experience.

 Shopify & E-Commerce

* Excellent written English and communication skills

title: Virtual Assistant – Video Coordination & Admin
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, organized virtual assistant to help coordinate video editors, review social media content, and handle general admin tasks.



**You don’t need video editing skills.** You do need a good eye for social media content, strong attention to detail, and the ability to keep work moving without constant reminders.



Your main responsibility will be managing the process between a video brief being ready and the finished video being approved.



### What you’ll do



**Coordinate video editors**

- Send editors clear briefs, footage, reference videos, and deadlines.

- Make sure they have everything they need before starting.

- Track assignments, follow up on progress, and flag delays early.

- Collect submissions and manage revision rounds.



**Review videos and give useful feedback**

- Check each submission against the brief and make sure nothing has been missed.

- Use your judgment to spot things that weaken the video: poor footage choices, awkward pacing, hard-to-read text, distracting transitions, or music that doesn’t fit.

- Check practical details such as spelling, captions, text placement, and formatting.

- Give clear, specific feedback that editors can act on—for example, “The text disappears too quickly at 0:06; please leave it on screen longer.”

- Check revised versions to confirm the requested changes have been made.



**Keep everything organized**

- Keep footage, briefs, submissions, and approved videos in the correct folders.

- Make sure files are named correctly and the latest versions are easy to find.

- Maintain an accurate tracker of assignments, deadlines, revisions, and approvals.

- Track editor invoices and payment status, and prepare payment details for my approval.



**Help with general VA tasks**

- Assist with research, data entry, document updates, scheduling, and other day-to-day admin as needed.

- Turn recurring tasks into simple checklists so the process stays consistent.



### You’ll be a good fit if you:

- Have experience as a VA, administrative assistant, project coordinator, or in a similar role.

- Are dependable, organized, and good at following through.

- Watch social media content regularly and can explain why a video feels engaging, confusing, polished, or poorly put together.

- Can follow a brief while also noticing things the brief hasn’t explicitly mentioned.

- Communicate clearly in written English and give constructive feedback.

- Ask questions when something is unclear and raise problems before they become urgent.

- Are comfortable using shared folders, spreadsheets, and task management tools.



Experience coordinating freelancers or reviewing social media content is a bonus. Video editing and graphic design skills are not required.

title: Creative Video Editor (Intermediate/Senior)
description:
Long-Form | Trailers | Motion Graphics | DaVinci Resolve | Full-Time Remote | Philippines**



We are building a premium, video-first long-form interview show featuring founders, executives, creators, academics, scientists, and people with compelling ideas and stories.



We are looking for a **full-time intermediate - Senior Creative Video Editor based in the Philippines** who can take ownership of the complete editorial experience.



This is not simply a podcast assembly role.



We need someone who can take raw footage and turn it into something that feels **cinematic, intelligent, emotional, modern, and highly watchable**.



You should be equally comfortable cutting a 90–120 minute conversation, building a compelling 60–120 second trailer, creating an engaging cold open/pre-story, adding motion graphics, shaping sound and music, and creating short-form content from the episode.



## WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will be responsible for the complete creative edit, including:



* Long-form YouTube episodes

* Multi-camera interview editing

* Story structure

* Pacing

* Dialogue editing

* Cold opens

* Pre-story sequences

* Cinematic trailers

* Teasers

* Short-form clips

* Motion graphics

* Text animation

* Visual storytelling

* Music selection and placement

* Sound design

* B-roll integration

* Camera angle selection

* Punch-ins and reframing

* Basic color correction and grading

* Audio cleanup and leveling

* Titles and lower thirds

* Transitions where appropriate

* Final polish

* Export and delivery



You should be able to take an editorial brief, transcript, selects, timecodes, and raw footage and build a polished piece without needing every creative decision specified for you.



## THE EDITOR WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should think like a **storyteller first and an editor second**.



You should understand:



* How to open with tension or curiosity

* How to build a trailer that makes someone want to watch the full episode

* How to create momentum without over-editing

* How to find emotional and intellectual peaks in a conversation

* How to shorten dialogue without making it feel unnatural

* How to use camera changes intentionally

* How to use music to create energy, tension, or emotion

* How to use graphics to clarify or elevate an idea

* How to create visual interest when the footage is primarily conversational

* How to build anticipation before a reveal

* When a sequence needs energy

* When a sequence needs space

* When to cut

* When not to cut



You should be able to watch a two-hour interview and identify the strongest story buried inside it.



## TRAILERS AND PRE-STORY EDITING



This is a major part of the role.



We are looking for someone who can build **high-quality cinematic trailers and pre-story sequences**, not simply assemble highlight clips.



A strong trailer should feel like a mini-story.



You should be able to:



* Find the strongest hook

* Create curiosity

* Reorder moments for maximum impact

* Build tension

* Use visual rhythm

* Create pauses and reveals

* Use music and sound design

* Add motion graphics and text where appropriate

* Use multiple camera angles effectively

* Use B-roll, archival material, imagery, graphics, or supporting visual assets

* Create a strong emotional or intellectual payoff

* End with a reason to watch the episode



Think **mini cinematic argument**, not highlight reel.



## MOTION GRAPHICS



You should be comfortable creating polished motion graphics directly in your editing workflow.



Examples may include:



* Animated typography

* Kinetic text

* Quotes

* Statistics

* Timelines

* Maps

* Diagrams

* Topic labels

* Visual explanations

* UI-style graphics

* Animated lower thirds

* Subtle transitions

* Callouts

* Social graphics

* Brand elements



You do not need to be a full-time motion designer, but you should be able to create professional motion work without relying on basic templates for everything.



Experience with **Fusion, After Effects, or similar tools** is strongly preferred.



## SOFTWARE



Our main editing environment is:



**DaVinci Resolve**



You should be highly comfortable working in Resolve, including:



* Edit page

* Fairlight

* Color

* Fusion

* Multicam

* Proxy workflows

* Project organization



Experience with **Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects** is also valuable.



## REQUIRED SKILLS



You should have strong experience in:



* DaVinci Resolve

* Multi-camera editing

* Long-form storytelling

* YouTube editing

* Interview editing

* Trailer editing

* Short-form editing

* Motion graphics

* Music editing

* Sound design

* Audio cleanup

* Color correction

* Visual pacing

* Typography

* Basic graphic design

* File organization

* Remote media workflows



Strong English comprehension is essential.



Our conversations often involve subtle ideas, humor, emotion, and complex subjects. You must understand the meaning behind what is being said, not simply recognize words.



## OUR EDITING STYLE



We want the work to feel:



* Cinematic

* Premium

* Intelligent

* Human

* Modern

* Emotionally aware

* Visually engaging

* Story-driven

* Clean

* Intentional



We do **not** want constant zooms, random sound effects, aggressive captions, or graphics every few seconds simply to create activity.



Every creative choice should have a reason.



Motion graphics should elevate the story.



Music should shape emotion.



Camera changes should support pacing.



Effects should never become the story.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Eventually, we want to be able to give you:



* The episode footage

* Transcript

* Story notes

* Selects

* Brand assets

* Editorial direction



And have you come back with:



1. A compelling long-form episode

2. A strong cold open

3. A cinematic trailer

4. A pre-story sequence

5. Several excellent short-form clips

6. Clean audio

7. Motion graphics

8. Music and sound design

9. A polished final master



Without needing us to prescribe every edit.



## WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



This role is probably not a fit if:



* Most of your experience is CapCut-style social editing

* You mainly create fast subtitle-heavy Reels

* You rely almost entirely on templates

* You need every cut specified by the producer

* You are uncomfortable editing long-form content

* You do not enjoy storytelling

* You avoid motion graphics

* You are uncomfortable working with large multi-camera projects



## FULL-TIME ROLE



This is intended to become a **full-time, long-term position**.



We want someone who becomes part of the creative team and develops a deep understanding of the show's editorial language.



You will initially work closely with the show's creator/editor and executive producer.



As you learn the show, we expect you to take increasing creative ownership.



## WORKING HOURS



This is a remote role based in the Philippines.



You do not need to work entirely on US hours, but some overlap will be required for communication, reviews, and handoffs.



We value reliability and ownership.



We care about:



* Meeting deadlines

* Clear communication

* Strong creative judgment

* Attention to detail

* Taking feedback well

* Improving with each project

* Taking responsibility for the finished product



## COMPENSATION



This is intended to become a  **full-time salaried position**.



Expected range: $400-$960/month depending on experience, portfolio quality, technical skill, storytelling ability, and creative ownership.



Exceptional candidates with intermediate/senior-level editorial and motion skills may be considered above this range.



## HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic application.



At the top of your application write:



**Kick As Editor here**



Then send exactly the following.



### 1. Best long-form edit



Send one example of a long-form interview, documentary, podcast, or YouTube video you edited.



Tell us specifically what you were responsible for.



### 2. Best trailer



Send the strongest trailer, teaser, cold open, or promo you have created.



We are especially interested in work that shows:



* Story

* Tension

* Music

* Sound design

* Pacing

* Creative structure



### 3. Best motion graphics example



Send one piece that demonstrates your motion graphics ability.



### 4. Best short-form edit



Send one short-form example only.



### 5. Answer these questions



**A. You receive a two-hour interview. How do you decide what the story is?**



**B. What makes a great trailer different from a highlight reel?**



**C. Describe how you would make a two-person conversation visually engaging without making it feel over-edited.**



**D. What role should music play in a trailer?**



**E. What motion graphics software do you use?**



Please list your level in each:



* DaVinci Resolve

* Fusion

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Illustrator



Use:



* Beginner

* Intermediate

* Advanced

* Expert



**F. Have you edited multicamera interviews?**



If yes, briefly describe the largest project you have handled.



**G. What computer do you edit on?**



Include:



* CPU

* RAM

* GPU

* Storage

* Internet speed



**H. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?**



**I. Are you currently working with other clients?**



If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



## PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete a **paid creative editing test**.



You will receive the same raw interview material as the other finalists.



The test may include approximately 8–12 minutes of multicamera footage.



You may be asked to create:



* A 60–90 second cold open or trailer

* A 2–3 minute story sequence



We will evaluate:



* Story judgment

* Hook

* Pacing

* Dialogue editing

* Camera choices

* Music

* Sound design

* Motion graphics

* Emotional rhythm

* Visual creativity

* Restraint

* Technical execution

* Overall polish



We are not looking for the person who uses the most effects.



We are looking for the person who can take ordinary raw footage and make it feel like something you cannot stop watching.



## FINAL NOTE



We are building this show for the long term.



We want an editor who wants to become part of the creative identity of the show, not someone simply looking for another editing queue.



If you care deeply about story, craft, pacing, sound, visuals, and making great work, we would like to see what you can do.



The key change is that this role is now really **Senior Creative Editor / Lead Editor**, not simply “Video Editor.”



I’d also raise the target compensation from the earlier range. If you genuinely want **one person who can do long-form + trailer + pre-story + Fusion/After Effects + sound + pacing + visual storytelling**, I’d start around **₱90K–₱140K/month**, and I would be prepared to go above that for someone truly excellent. Otherwise you risk finding a good assembler rather than the creative partner you're describing.

title: YouTube Video Editor (REMOTE) - Canadian Company
description:
We are a Canadian digital media company managing YouTube channels with over 2 million subscribers combined. We produce long-form content for our own channels and for partner creators in the horror, mystery and storytelling space. We are hiring a full-time remote video editor based in the Philippines to join our editing team and grow with it.



Before You Apply



You need to have edited long-form YouTube videos (10 minutes or longer) that are published, and you need to have used at least one AI video generation tool such as Google Flow / Veo, Vidu, Kling or Runway on a real edit, even a personal project. We are hiring for fundamentals and potential, and we will train you on our style and workflow.



The Role



You will be the dedicated editor for one or two of our channels, delivering videos from raw footage to publish-ready: cuts, captions, sound design, music, and AI-generated inserts. The standard workload is 12 videos per month.



Our delivery standard is 48 hours from assignment. Footage arrives throughout the week, so we need editors who can plan their own schedule around that commitment rather than work a fixed Monday-to-Friday block.



You will be onboarded by our lead editor using a documented style guide and AI workflow, and your first videos will be reviewed before delivery. A coordinator manages scheduling and communication so you can focus on editing. Each assignment arrives as a ClickUp task with the source files, the style guide, and a due date.



Requirements



* Published long-form YouTube editing work you can link to

* Hands-on use of at least one AI video generation tool (Google Flow / Veo, Vidu, Kling, Runway or similar)

* Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

* Solid fundamentals in pacing, sound design and captions

* Strong English comprehension, written and spoken

* A workstation capable of handling 4K timelines and stable high-speed internet

* Able to consistently meet a 48-hour delivery standard

* Coachable, organized, and reliable with deadlines



Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time independent contractor, flexible schedule based on deliverables

* Monthly base starting at ₱30,000 for 12 videos

* ₱2,500 for each video above 12 in a month

* ₱1,500 bonus per rush (24-hour) delivery

* Paid twice monthly via Wise, on the 1st and 15th

* 30-day initial period



What You Get



* 100% remote with flexible hours

* Consistent, long-term work with a growing team

* Structured onboarding and mentorship from an experienced lead editor

* Daily work with current AI video tools, and a clear path to higher rates as your speed and quality grow



How to Apply



Please include:



* Links to 2 published long-form YouTube videos you edited

* One example of a clip or video where you used an AI video tool, with the tool named

* Your editing software, computer specs, and internet speed



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short, compensated skills assessment using our style guide.



About the Contract



This is an independent contractor arrangement. You will have consistent full-time work, a fixed monthly base with per-video upside, and a stable team. We pay on schedule and invest in the people who grow with us.

s, Instagram and

title: Long-Term Video Editor for GRiT - Long-form Videos + Social Cutdowns
description:
GRiT is seeking a reliable video editor for an ongoing working relationship. The primary responsibility is to turn raw recordings into polished long-form videos and then repurpose the strongest moments into short-form social content.

This is not a shorts-only position. You must have experience shaping long-form spoken content, improving pacing, removing unnecessary material, and finding compelling moments that work as standalone shorts.

Monthly workload



The initial monthly package will include:

- Two long-form videos per month

- Approximately 10–20 finished minutes per long-form video

- Up to 90 minutes of organized raw footage per episode

- Four vertical shorts derived from each long-form video

- Eight shorts total per month

- Two consolidated revision rounds for each long-form video and its related shorts:  Two reasonable revision rounds are included for each episode package. One episode package consists of the long-form master and its four associated shorts. Revision requests must be consolidated into one list per round. Revisions cover adjustments to the agreed edit—not complete re-edits, replacement footage submitted after editing begins, or a change in creative direction.

- Editable project files

- Long-form responsibilities

Review and organize supplied raw footage

- Remove mistakes, false starts, long pauses and unnecessary repetition

- Create a coherent story with professional pacing

- Clean and level dialogue audio

- Add appropriate music and sound effects

- Perform basic color correction

- Add relevant B-roll, titles and supporting graphics

- Follow GRiT’s brand guidelines

- Export the finished master in horizontal 16:9 format

- Short-form responsibilities



Initial long-form draft delivered within five business days of receiving complete materials. 

Associated shorts delivered within two business days after approval of the long-form master.



After completing the long-form master, you will:

- Identify the strongest standalone moments

- Create compelling openings or hooks

- Reframe footage for vertical 9:16 delivery

- Add accurate, branded captions

- Add B-roll, punch-ins, graphics and sound effects where appropriate

- Keep each short focused on one complete idea

- Export for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts



Compensation: $400–$600 USD per month, depending on experience, portfolio quality and final scope.

Please provide your proposed monthly rate for this exact workload, even if it differs from the listed range.



Paid trial

Shortlisted candidates will receive the same source footage and instructions. The trial will require:

One polished 2–3 minute horizontal edit

One 30–60 second vertical short derived from that edit

Captions and basic GRiT branding

One revision round

Editable project files

Trial compensation: $50–$75 USD.

Do not create an unpaid sample when applying.



Requirements

Demonstrated experience editing both long-form and short-form content

Strong storytelling and pacing skills

Ability to identify compelling short-form moments within longer recordings

Strong written English and accurate captioning

Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent professional software

Reliable computer and internet connection

Consistent communication and dependable delivery

Ability to follow reference videos and brand guidelines

Willingness to provide editable project files

Properly licensed music, stock footage, fonts and other third-party assets



How to apply

Begin your application with the word GRIT. Include:

Your country and time zone.

Links to one or two long-form videos you personally edited.

Links to three short-form videos you personally edited.

A description of what you completed in each sample.

Your editing software and computer specifications.

Your normal turnaround time for one long-form video and four derived shorts.

Your proposed monthly price for the stated workload.

The number of revision rounds included.

Your current weekly availability.

Confirmation that editable project files are included.

The maximum amount of raw footage included in your price.

Applications containing only a general showreel, with no complete long-form samples, will not be considered.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok / Reels / Shorts
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and creative short-form video editor to help edit content for my social media pages on an ongoing basis.



I’m specifically looking for someone who can study my current videos and closely replicate my existing editing style so that every new video maintains the same branding, pacing, and overall feel.



Most videos are approximately 35–70 seconds long and are created for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What You’ll Be Doing:



You’ll be responsible for editing a minimum of 3 videos per week, with a 24-hour maximum turnaround time after receiving the necessary footage and assets.



For most videos, I will provide:

* The completed script

* Talking-head footage

* Images and/or visual assets

* Additional direction when something specific is required



However, you must also be comfortable sourcing your own high-quality images, B-roll, and visual assets when needed. Anything you source should fit naturally with the branding and visual style of my current videos.



Edits may include:



* Fast-paced cuts

* On-screen captions and text

* Images and B-roll

* Zooms and motion

* Sound effects

* Relevant visual effects

* Background elements

* Other editing techniques used throughout my existing content



The biggest requirement is your ability to study my current content and replicate the style. I’m not looking to completely reinvent the editing format. I want someone who can understand the pacing, captions, image selection, timing, effects, and overall editing language and consistently recreate it.



Requirements

You must:

* Have experience editing short-form vertical content (9:16)

* Be able to closely replicate an established editing style

* Have strong attention to detail

* Use high-quality visual assets

* Properly sync captions and visual elements with the spoken content

* Check spelling and captions before submitting

* Avoid low-resolution, watermarked, stretched, or poorly cropped assets

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Be receptive to feedback and revisions

* Consistently meet a 24-hour turnaround time



You may use CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or another editing program as long as the final product matches the required style.



Pay & Long-Term Opportunity



Pay: $5 USD per completed video



The starting workload is a minimum of 3 videos per week.



However, if you’re a great editor and your editing style is a strong fit, expect HIGH VOLUME! I create content consistently across multiple social media pages, and I’m looking for an editor I can trust with significantly more videos over time.



The goal is to find someone who understands the style, gets faster and better with each video, and can become my go-to editor for ongoing content. If we work well together, there will be plenty of videos to edit.



Trial Video



Candidates who appear to be a good fit will be asked to complete one unpaid trial video before being selected for ongoing work.



The trial is designed to see how well you can follow directions, replicate the editing style of my existing content, and deliver a polished short-form video.



Please review my current content carefully before applying.



To apply, DM me on Instagram 
 with the exact words “BIG BRAIN EDITOR.” I will not respond to messages on Onlinejobs.ph, only through Instagram DM



In your DM, please also include:



1. A link to the short-form video you’ve edited that you’re most proud of.

2. Which video on my page you think is edited the best and one sentence explaining why.



Please do not send only “Hi,” “I’m interested,” or a generic application.



If you’ve read this far and followed the instructions above, you’re already ahead of most applicants.



Looking forward to finding an editor who can grow with the page!

title: Credit Analyst - Australian Lender
description:
# Credit Analyst – Australian Lending Experience Required



## About the Role



We are an Australian-based private lender seeking a detail-oriented,  Credit Analyst to support our credit assessment team.



You will review customers’ financial information and prepare clear, accurate summaries to assist our assessors in making responsible lending decisions.



**Previous lending experience is essential. Applicants without relevant lending, consumer finance experience will not be considered.**



## Key Responsibilities



* Review customers’ bank transaction data covering the previous 90 days.

* Accurately categorise income, living expenses, liabilities and loan commitments.

* Identify financial behaviours such as gambling, buy now pay later services, payday loans, wage advances, overdrafts and dishonoured payments.

* Compare recurring income and expenses to identify patterns, inconsistencies or unusual transactions.

* Prepare clear, structured summaries for credit assessors.

* Flag missing information, discrepancies and matters requiring further investigation.

* Follow established assessment procedures and compliance requirements.

* Maintain strict privacy, confidentiality and data-security standards.



## Essential Requirements



* Previous experience working in lending, consumer finance, credit assessment 

* Experience reviewing bank statements and categorising transaction data.

* Strong understanding of income, expenses, liabilities and loan commitments.

* Ability to recognise transaction patterns, anomalies and potential risk indicators.

* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

* Ability to follow structured processes, policies and compliance requirements.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Experience using lending or financial-analysis platforms is highly regarded.



## Privacy and Data Handling



This role involves access to sensitive personal and financial information. All work must be completed in accordance with strict privacy, confidentiality and data-security requirements.



Customer information must never be downloaded, stored, copied, shared or used outside the authorised platform or approved business processes.



## Application Requirements



Please submit:



* Your current résumé.

* Details of your previous lending, credit assessment or fintech experience.

* A brief explanation of how you have previously reviewed and categorised bank transaction data.

* An anonymised example showing how you would group transactions into categories such as income, rent, utilities, gambling, BNPL, payday loans and discretionary spending.



Any example provided must be fully anonymised. Do not include real customer names, account numbers, addresses, transaction references or other identifying information.



## Why Join Us?



* Work with a fast-growing Australian lender.

* Join a scalable, technology-driven lending business.

* Develop your skills in credit analysis and responsible lending.

* Build a long-term career with opportunities for professional growth.

This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can look at an account, understand what is working and what isn't, and make smart decisions to improve performance.

- Meta Ads

- Campaign budgets and bidding strategies

- Analyse product-level performance

- Structure PMax campaigns properly

- Scale campaigns while maintaining ROAS/profitability



We need someone who understands **why a Shopping or PMax campaign is performing the way it is**, not someone who simply follows Google's recommendations.



## Campaign Troubleshooting



A major part of this role is improving accounts that are not performing.



You should be able to quickly investigate:



- Rising CPA or falling ROAS

- High CPCs

- Poor search terms

- Wasted spend

- Tracking problems

- Poor campaign structure

- Incorrect targeting

- Budget issues

- Poor-performing products

- Landing page problems

- Conversion-rate issues

- Lead quality



You should be comfortable developing a clear action plan and implementing the changes yourself.



## Tracking & Technical Skills



You should have strong working knowledge of:



- Google Tag Manager

- GA4

- Google Ads conversion tracking

- Enhanced Conversions

- Meta Pixel

- Meta Conversions API

- Ecommerce tracking

- Offline conversions

- CRM/lead-quality tracking

- Attribution and tracking QA



You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be able to identify tracking problems and explain or implement the fix.



## Meta Ads



You should also be experienced with:



- Lead generation

- Ecommerce

- Prospecting and retargeting

- Creative testing

- Audience testing

- Offers and messaging

- Budget optimisation

- Scaling

- Conversion tracking



You should understand that Meta performance isn't just about audiences — **creative, offer, landing page and tracking all matter.**



## What We're Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



- 5–7+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience

- Advanced Google Ads experience

- Strong Google Shopping and PMax experience

- Strong Meta Ads experience

- Google Merchant Center experience

- Strong tracking knowledge

- Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets

- Experience with both ecommerce and lead generation

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

- Australian market experience preferred



Most importantly, we want someone who can **show us campaigns they have personally improved.**



## What We Want to See When You Apply



Please provide **2–3 examples of accounts you have personally managed**.



For each example, briefly tell us:



**1. What was the problem?**  

What wasn't working?



**2. What did you change?**  

What actions did you personally take?



**3. What was the result?**  

Show us the before-and-after numbers where possible — CPA, ROAS, revenue, conversions, CPL or other relevant metrics.



**4. How long did it take?**



Screenshots or anonymised evidence are strongly encouraged.



We don't need a 10-page case study. We want to see that you understand performance marketing and can back up your experience with real results.



## The Right Person



We're looking for someone who:



- Takes ownership of their accounts

- Checks performance regularly

- Spots problems early

- Understands the numbers

- Doesn't make random changes

- Can explain why they are making a change

- Tests and measures properly

title: SEO & Google Ads Specialist - Shopify eCommerce
description:
GOOGLE ADS & SEO SPECIALIST - eCommerce Growth for Car Tech Brand (Long-term, Part-time Retainer)



ABOUT US

We run a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling smartphone integration modules (wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) for BMW, Mercedes and Audi. We ship from local warehouses in Europe, the UK and the US. All our growth so far has come from paid social - it works, and now we want a second engine. Google is completely untouched: no Search ads, no Shopping, barely any SEO. You'd be building it from zero and owning it.



THE JOB

- Google Ads: build and run Search and Shopping campaigns for our products. Fixed monthly budget, measured on one number: cost per sale in our Shopify data

- Google Merchant Center: keep our product feed healthy and our products approved

- Technical SEO on our Shopify store: titles, meta descriptions, headings, structure, schema, internal links, speed

- Keyword research and on-page SEO for product pages and our blog guides. Important: we write the car facts, you optimize. Our niche punishes wrong technical details, so content accuracy stays with us

- AI search visibility: we already get customers who found us by asking ChatGPT. Making our pages the ones AI recommends matters to us as much if not more as classic rankings

- Competitor research in our niche

- Search Console + GA4: monitor rankings and organic traffic, catch problems, find opportunities

- Weekly report: what you did, what changed, what you need from us

- Bonus scope: SEO-optimize captions and hashtags for our social posts (content itself stays with our team)



The hard part of this job is not running campaigns. It's honesty when something isn't working. Most SEO reports look great while sales stay flat. We check everything against real store sales, and we'd rather hear "this isn't working, here's what I'd change" than receive a beautiful dashboard.



HOURS & PAY

About 10-15 hours per week - front-loaded at the start (site audit, campaign setup), then ongoing optimization

€350/month retainer, paid weekly via Wise

First month is a paid trial at a reduced rate - full rate from month two

Long-term role: we're expanding into new product lines and markets, and this role grows with the brand

Ad budget is ours and separate from your pay - you'll never be asked to "make it work" without money behind it



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven Google Ads experience for eCommerce - Search and Shopping, not lead generation. Show us, don't tell us

- SEO experience with Shopify stores specifically

- Merchant Center and product feed experience

- Comfortable with Search Console, GA4, and at least one of Ahrefs / Semrush / Search Atlas or similar

- Strong written English and honest reporting

- Able to work independently and tell us what you need instead of waiting to be asked

- Bonus, not required: you know cars, or you've worked in automotive niches



TO APPLY

1. Tell us about one eCommerce store where your Google Ads made real sales: roughly what budget, what you sold, and what cost per sale you reached

2. Answer this: we give you €600/month ad budget for a product that sells at €289. Which campaigns would you launch first, and what cost per sale would you aim for to keep this profitable?

3. Tell us one thing you'd check first on any Shopify store's SEO before touching anything else

4. Confirm the €400/month rate works for you at these hours

5. Start your application with the word ENGINE so we know you read this

title: Expert Interview: Philippines LPG Market & Industry Outlook
description:
ASEAN Japan Consulting Co., Ltd. (Japan) and Kaigai Advisory Co., Ltd. (Thailand).

With more than 20 years of experience in market research and strong connections with various Japanese companies across Thailand and the ASEAN region, we also serve as consultants to Japanese independent administrative institutions (Bangkok offices) and the Japanese Chamber of Commerce, Bangkok (JCC).



We are currently conducting research on the LPG industry in the Philippines and are looking to speak with an experienced industry professional for a one-hour expert interview.



This is not for a specific job position. We are looking to speak with someone who has practical experience and knowledge of the LPG industry in the Philippines, particularly someone who can provide insights from an industry or business perspective.



The purpose of the interview is to assess the growth potential of the LPG business in the Philippines, as well as to understand the potential restrictions, challenges, and risks if a company were to enter or expand its business in this sector.



The main topics we would like to discuss include:



■ LPG Market Overview – LPG consumption by customer segment, major players, and future growth trends

■ LPG Business Structure – Retail/distribution business models, supply sources (imported vs. domestically produced), and profit structure across the value chain

■ Regulations & Licensing – Required licenses, permits, documentation, application procedures, and safety/fire-related requirements

■ Business Practices – General business practices in the Philippines and key considerations when dealing with PEZA-registered companies

title: Expert Email Designer and Copywriter - Klaviyo
description:
About us



We are an Australian direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling creatine gummies on Shopify. We run a subscription programme through Appstle and all our
 runs through Klaviyo. We are entering our biggest quarter, with a new product format launching and our first serious Black Friday.



The role



We need someone to take ownership of our
 programme. Right now the founders run it, and it is not getting the attention it needs. Nine flows are live but several carry outdated product information. Nine more flows do not exist at all. Campaigns have been inconsistent.



This is not a send-the-newsletter job. You will own strategy, segmentation, copy, build, QA and reporting.



What you will work on



Fix and modernise the existing flows. Welcome, site abandonment, browse abandonment, abandoned cart and abandoned checkout. Several still show our old packaging and old serving information and need rebuilding around the new product.



Build the flows we are missing. In priority order:



Subscriber onboarding, roughly seven
s across the first week

Post-purchase for one-time buyers, six
s including a review request

Failed payment recovery, triggered from Appstle transaction failures

Subscription cancellation and win-back

Skip and delay intervention, before a customer reaches cancellation

Replenishment for one-time buyers

Sunset and list hygiene

Rebuild the transactional
s. Order confirmation, shipping confirmation and delivered confirmation are currently Shopify defaults. These have our highest open rates and are doing nothing.



Run a consistent campaign programme. Three campaigns a week on fixed days, with a real mix of education, social proof and promotion rather than discount after discount.



Deliver Black Friday. We have a three-window structure running mid November to early December, with an
-only early access period before the public sale. You will build the calendar, the segmentation and the suppression rules, and produce a higher send volume through that period.



Segmentation and retention. Build a proper active-subscriber segment from Appstle events and treat subscribers differently from prospects. Our subscription cancellations and failed payments are the biggest problem in the account.



What you need



Real Klaviyo experience, building flows and segments, not just scheduling campaigns

Shopify experience

Appstle or another subscription app such as Recharge or Skio. Say which one and what you did with it

Strong written English. You will be writing customer-facing copy in an Australian brand voice

Able to read a report and tell us what to change, not just what happened

Nice to have



 design production, or tell us if you need designs supplied

SMS experience in Klaviyo

Supplement, health or subscription ecommerce background

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Storage Unit / Reselling Content (POV Vlog Style)
description:
Type: Part-time to full-time, long-term (remote, Philippines-based)

Pay: $400–$600/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

Start: Paid test edit ($10–$20) before any commitment



About the content

I buy storage units at auction and film the entire process. Each finished video is 15–20+ minutes and follows this format:

1.  Intro to camera — "I just bought this unit for $X, let's see what I found."

2.  POV searching footage — the bulk of the video is shot on Meta smart glasses and a body cam while I dig through the unit, narrating what I'm finding in real time.

3.  Value reveals — as items are found, big on-screen text pop-ups show what they're worth ("$87!"), sold eBay comp screenshots appear on screen, and money sound effects (ka-ching) play.

Think treasure-hunt / unboxing vlog pacing: the hook is the discovery, the payoff is the value reveal.

Style reference

Harrison Nevel on YouTube — same genre (buying storage units at auction, going through them on camera). His videos are very polished, pro-level work with a cameraman; I don't expect that level, but he's the right reference for the format: intro hook, searching footage, and value reveals. Example: "I Risked $1020 On An Abandoned Storage Unit..." — 

Aim for a solid, watchable version of that energy: clean cuts, clear value pop-ups, and pacing that keeps people watching.

What you'll do

•  Cut 1–3 hours of raw multi-camera footage down to a tight 15–20 minute video

•  Aggressively cut dead air and boring searching — keep the pacing snappy

•  Add animated value pop-ups, sold eBay comp screenshots (I provide the comps and values, you place and style them), and money sound effects

•  Background music that fits the energy without overpowering narration

•  Light color/exposure matching between camera sources (Meta glasses, body cam, intro camera)

•  Strong hooks — the first 30 seconds need to sell the video

•  Export in 1080p (YouTube-ready), organized project files

Requirements

•  2+ years editing YouTube content (vlog, unboxing, POV, or creator-style — not corporate)

•  Expert in Premiere Pro (After Effects or CapCut Pro a plus)

•  Strong sense of pacing: you know when to cut, when to linger on a find, when to drop a sound effect

•  Good written English for on-screen text

•  Portfolio with at least 2–3 examples of creator-style or vlog editing

•  Reliable internet and your own editing setup

How to apply

1.  Send a link to your portfolio (YouTube links preferred)

2.  Tell me your editing software and how many years you've been editing creator content

3.  Answer: what's your process for keeping a 15-minute vlog video engaging from start to finish?

Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test edit ($10–$20): a short segment of real footage to edit in the style described above. This is the main thing I hire on — show me the pacing, the pop-ups, and the sound design.

description:

This is not a role for someone who simply waits for instructions. We want someone with excellent English, good judgment and attention to detail who can learn our systems, spot problems and take initiative without needing constant supervision.



If something does not look right, a deadline may be missed or you notice a mistake, we expect you to flag it and take sensible action rather than waiting for management to find it.

Good availability during UK GMT/BST working hours and a reliable computer and internet connection are required.



PROXY AND ANTI-DETECT EXPERIENCE

Experience with Multilogin, AdsPower, residential or ISP proxies, managing browser profiles or troubleshooting proxy connections is particularly useful.

 QuickBooks Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks (Online & Desktop). QuickBooks ProAdvisor or Advanced Certification is highly preferred (please provide copy if available).

 Multi-Company Experience: Minimum 3–5+ years managing accounting, expense tracking, and tax returns for multiple healthcare/medical entities.

 Technical Workspace Setup: High-speed internet with backup power and a secure, private workspace suitable for confidential US financial and health-related records.



How to Apply

title: Real Estate ISA / Appointment Setter – Vulcan7 Experience Required
description:
Real Estate ISA / Appointment Setter – Vulcan7 Experience Required



Part-Time | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity



I am a residential real estate broker in the Portland, Oregon metro area looking for an experienced Real Estate ISA / Appointment Setter to join me part-time.



This is NOT a general VA position.



Your primary responsibility will be calling homeowners, having genuine conversations, identifying potential sellers, following up, and setting qualified listing appointments directly on my calendar.



Who I’m Looking For



I am specifically looking for someone who has worked on the traditional Realtor/listing-agent side of the business.



Strong preference for experience with:



* Vulcan7

* Expired Listings

* FSBOs

* Circle Prospecting

* Probate / inherited-property leads

* Downsizers / likely-to-sell homeowners

* Seller lead follow-up

* Objection handling

* Appointment setting

* U.S. residential real estate



Experience with Mike Ferry, Brandon Mulrenin, Tom Ferry, REDX, Vulcan7 or similar prospecting systems is a plus.



IMPORTANT — This Is NOT a Wholesale Acquisition Position



Please do not apply if your only real estate experience is:



* Wholesaling

* Investor acquisitions

* Cash-offer campaigns

* BPO work

* Skip tracing

* Calling distressed homeowners for investors



Wholesale experience does not automatically disqualify you, but you must also have experience having conversations with homeowners on behalf of traditional residential real estate agents or teams.



I am looking for someone who understands the difference between:



“Would you consider a cash offer on your property?”



and having a genuine conversation that ultimately results in a listing appointment with a Realtor.



What You’ll Do



You will work with my existing lead sources, including Vulcan7.



Your calls will include:



Expired & FSBO: Call fresh leads, follow up consistently, uncover motivation, handle objections and schedule qualified listing appointments.



Circle Prospecting: Call homeowners in targeted neighborhoods to identify future sellers, downsizers and potential off-market opportunities.



Probate: Eventually contact appropriate probate/inherited-property prospects using a separate, more sensitive approach.



Follow-Up: Continue working prospects who aren’t ready today but may sell in the coming months.



This is not about making one call and moving on.



I want someone who understands that consistent follow-up creates appointments.



Primary KPI



Your most important result is:



Qualified seller appointments that actually HOLD.



Call volume matters, but conversations, opportunities and appointments matter more.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years have you worked as a Real Estate ISA?

2. How many years have you called Expired Listings?

3. How many years have you called FSBOs?

4. Have you done Circle Prospecting? Describe what you did.

5. Have you called Probate or inherited-property leads?

6. Have you personally used Vulcan7? If yes, for how long?

7. What other dialers/CRMs have you used?

8. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous position?

9. Approximately how many meaningful homeowner conversations did you have per day?

10. Approximately how many appointments did you normally set per week?

11. Were those appointments for traditional Realtors/listing agents or investors/wholesalers?

12. What real estate scripts or training systems have you used?

13. What is your requested hourly rate?



REQUIRED 60-SECOND VOICE RECORDING



Please include a voice recording with your application.



I want to hear how you sound speaking naturally to a U.S. homeowner.



Please record yourself delivering the following script. Don’t rush it. Imagine you are actually speaking with the homeowner.



Golden Call Script



“Hi John?”



“John, look, I’ll be upfront. I’m calling for a local Realtor, Tom Baker, and I didn’t want to call and bother you, but I was just hoping to ask you something really quick. Would that be okay?”



“I appreciate that. Tom’s been meaning to reach out for a while, but honestly, he was worried you’d get upset.



The reason I’m calling is because Tom is working with a really nice couple who’s looking to buy a three-bedroom, single-level ranch just like yours here in the neighborhood, but they’re having a hard time finding anything on the market.



But… I get the feeling you’re probably in your forever home and you’re never selling… right?”



Then STOP.



Imagine the homeowner is about to answer you.



I’m listening for natural English, warmth, confidence, pacing, tonality and whether you sound like someone a homeowner would actually want to continue talking with.



Please do not submit an AI-generated voice recording.



Interview Process



Applicants who appear to be a good fit will be invited to a short video interview.



Final candidates will complete live role-play calls with me.



I will pretend to be:



* An Expired homeowner

* A FSBO

* A homeowner receiving a Circle Prospecting call



You will not receive the objections ahead of time.



I’m not looking for someone who simply memorizes scripts.



I’m looking for someone who can listen, ask good questions, build rapport, uncover motivation, handle objections and naturally move the conversation toward an appointment.



Compensation



Approximately 10–12 hours per week to start.



Target compensation is approximately $5–$7 USD/hour depending on experience, with the opportunity to earn additional performance bonuses for qualified seller appointments that actually hold.



Initial monthly budget is approximately $300, with the potential to increase hours and compensation if the position produces results.



Long-Term Opportunity



I’m looking for one great ISA, not a large call center.



If you are dependable, communicate well, follow up consistently and generate legitimate seller appointments, I’d like this to become a long-term working relationship.



If you have real experience with Vulcan7 + Expireds + FSBOs + Circle Prospecting, I especially want to hear from you.

title: AI-Powered Full-Stack Developer
description:
AI-Powered Full-Stack Developer

Full-Time | Remote | Asia



MedAlert is looking for a highly capable, AI-native developer who knows how to use tools like Claude Code and Claude to build software quickly, solve technical problems and take ownership of a growing ecosystem of applications, websites, automations and infrastructure.



This is not a traditional full-stack development role.



We are specifically looking for someone who has embraced AI-powered software development and understands how to use AI as the primary development engine, while still having enough technical knowledge to understand the code, diagnose issues, work with APIs, manage servers and make good technical decisions.



We move quickly and expect the person in this role to do the same.



You might be the right person if you are the type of developer who can be given an idea in the morning, work through it with Claude Code, solve the technical problems as they arise and have a functional version running later that day.





About MedAlert



MedAlert provides personal medical alert watches and connected technology designed to help monitor and protect elderly and vulnerable people.



Behind the watches is a growing technology platform covering watch management, alerts, health information, reseller management, mobile applications, SIM connectivity, billing, fulfilment and automation.



We are now looking for someone to take technical ownership of this ecosystem and continue improving it.





What You Will Be Responsible For



You will become the primary technical person responsible for maintaining, improving and building MedAlert's software systems.



Your work will cover a mixture of software development, AI-assisted development, infrastructure, integrations, automation, product development and technical support.





MedAlert Guardian Platform



We have developed a watch management platform that allows users to manage MedAlert watches and monitor watch wearers.



The platform includes functionality such as:



* Watch registration and management

* Wearer profiles

* Fall alerts

* SOS and other watch alerts

* Step tracking

* Health information and AI-powered health metrics

* Notifications and automated alerts

* Device monitoring

* Account management



The platform also includes a reseller portal where MedAlert resellers can:



* Create and manage reseller accounts

* Manage watch inventory

* Allocate watches to customers

* Manage their end clients

* Monitor devices and accounts



You will be responsible for maintaining and improving this platform, developing new functionality and helping shape the product as it evolves.





MedAlert Guardian Mobile App



We have also developed a mobile application using **Claude Code and Expo**, connected to the MedAlert Guardian platform.



You will take ownership of the app and continue developing new features, improving performance and maintaining the integration between the mobile app and the wider MedAlert platform.





Websites and New Digital Products



You will work with the MedAlert leadership team to redesign and improve existing websites and build new websites using Claude Code and AI-powered development.



We also have a new children's watch brand being launched, and one of your upcoming projects will be developing the new website and digital experience for that brand.



Strong experience using **Claude Design and AI-assisted design workflows** will be highly valued.



You do not need to be a traditional graphic designer. We are looking for someone who knows how to collaborate with leadership, turn rough ideas into strong designs and then build them quickly using AI.





Internal Tools and Automation



MedAlert operates several internal services and automation tools deployed across **Render and DigitalOcean**.



These systems perform functions including:



* Subscription billing automation

*
 automations

* SIM card activation and deactivation

* Watch provisioning

* Internal workflows

* Shopify integrations

* ShipBob fulfilment automation

* API integrations between platforms

* Webhook-based automations



You will take ownership of these systems, troubleshoot them when something breaks and improve them over time.





Infrastructure and Server Monitoring



MedAlert also operates a GPS relay server hosted on a **DigitalOcean Droplet**.



This server receives inbound data directly from MedAlert watches and relays that information into the MedAlert Guardian platform.



You will need to understand how this system works and be responsible for:



* Monitoring server availability

* Investigating outages

* Reviewing logs

* Troubleshooting connectivity issues

* Maintaining services

* Deploying updates

* Diagnosing API and network issues

* Ensuring inbound watch data continues flowing correctly



When something goes down, we need someone who can work out what happened and get it working again quickly.





Hardware and Watch Expertise



This role goes beyond software.



You will become one of MedAlert's internal technical experts on the watches themselves.



You will learn:



* How the watches communicate with our servers

* SIM connectivity and mobile network behaviour

* GPS communication

* Device configuration

* Watch firmware and software behaviour

* Data protocols

* Alerts and notifications

* Hardware troubleshooting

* Watch provisioning



You will work directly with our manufacturer's technical contact when required to obtain documentation, understand device behaviour and troubleshoot issues.



You may also occasionally join Zoom calls with MedAlert staff, partners or resellers to explain technical issues or provide second-level technical support.





The Type of Developer We Want



We are not looking for someone who spends days manually writing code that Claude Code could produce in an hour.



We want someone who understands modern AI-powered development and knows how to combine AI with solid software fundamentals.



Your workflow should naturally involve tools like Claude Code throughout the development process.



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Build applications

* Generate and refactor code

* Debug technical issues

* Design interfaces

* Build APIs

* Create database structures

* Analyse logs

* Understand unfamiliar codebases

* Build integrations

* Write tests

* Deploy applications

* Research technical problems

* Rapidly prototype new ideas



At the same time, you need enough technical knowledge to recognise when AI has produced bad code, understand why something is failing and make sensible architectural decisions.





Technical Skills



You do not need to be a senior traditional software engineer, but you should have strong working knowledge of:



* JavaScript

* TypeScript

* APIs

title: Technical SEO Developer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself
