title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Schedule: Primarily EST business hours

Type: Full-Time / Part-Time

Compensation: Base + Commission / Performance-Based Compensation



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing sales team. This role is focused on outbound calling, lead generation, and booking qualified calls with our design team.



You will be responsible for identifying potential clients, contacting decision-makers, qualifying opportunities, and scheduling calls with our design team. The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, highly organized, persistent, and comfortable making a high volume of calls.



This is a results-driven position where your earning potential increases as you generate qualified opportunities and sales.



Key Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to prospective clients and companies.

* Follow up with existing leads and prospects through phone and other communication channels.

* Qualify prospects and identify potential projects and opportunities.

* Book qualified meetings directly with our design team.

* Respond to inbound leads and work to convert them into qualified sales calls.

* Maintain accurate records of all contacts, calls, conversations, and follow-ups in Pipedrive CRM.

* Add new contacts and companies to Pipedrive and ensure all relevant information is properly documented.

* Track follow-ups and maintain an organized sales pipeline.

* Use our RingCentral phone system for outbound and inbound calls.

* All calls will be recorded for training, quality control, and performance purposes.

* Follow established sales scripts, processes, and qualification criteria.

* Consistently follow up with prospects until they are qualified, booked, or determined not to be a fit.

* Work closely with the design and sales teams to ensure qualified opportunities are properly handed off.

What We're Looking For



Required:



* Previous experience in appointment setting, cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or sales development.

* Proven experience successfully booking sales meetings or generating qualified leads.

* English proficiency of 8/10 or higher, both spoken and written.

* Excellent communication and phone skills.

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

* Confident speaking with business owners, executives, managers, and other decision-makers.

Strong follow-up skills and persistence.

Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Comfortable working with CRM systems.

Ability to accurately document calls, notes, follow-ups, and next steps.

Reliable internet connection and a professional work environment.

Ability to work primarily during EST business hours.

Experience With



Experience with the following is considered an asset:



Pipedrive or other CRM platforms

RingCentral or similar VoIP phone systems

Cold calling

B2B sales

Appointment setting

Lead generation

Trade shows, events, construction, architecture, manufacturing, or related industries

Compensation



This is a performance-driven compensation structure.



You will have the opportunity to earn commission on:



Qualified inbound leads that you successfully convert into booked calls

Outbound calls and leads that result in qualified opportunities

Monthly sales generated from the opportunities you develop



The more qualified opportunities and sales you generate, the more you can earn.



What Success Looks Like



A successful SDR in this position will:



Consistently make outbound calls every day.

Generate a steady flow of qualified leads.

Book high-quality meetings with our design team.

Maintain a clean and accurate Pipedrive pipeline.

Follow up consistently and professionally.

Turn conversations into real sales opportunities.

Contribute directly to monthly revenue.

Important



This is not a passive lead-following position. We are looking for someone who enjoys picking up the phone, starting conversations, overcoming objections, and creating opportunities.

title: SMM Specialist for E-commerce
description:
Social Media Manager (Instagram + Threads) for an E-commerce Brand: Fixed Salary + Commission on Organic Sales



About us

We're an e-commerce brand selling premium pure copper water bottles, a simple daily health ritual rooted in Ayurvedic tradition. Our team already includes designers and video editors. Now we need the person who brings it all together and turns our social media into a real sales channel.



What you'll do

- Own our Instagram and Threads content calendar and publish consistently:

  - 1 Instagram Story every day

  - 4 feed posts per week

  - 3 Reels per week

- Coordinate our designers and video editors: write clear briefs, give feedback, keep everyone on deadline.

- Run our Threads account every day: write posts, tell stories, start conversations, reply to people and build an engaged community around the brand.

- Spot trends and formats that can take off on Reels and Threads and bring in new audiences.

- Reply to comments and DMs and turn conversations into sales.

- Track what works (reach, followers, link clicks, sales) and send a short weekly report.



Big plus

- Experience with commenting and engagement strategy on Instagram and Threads: engaging on relevant accounts and posts to bring new people to our profile.



Who we're looking for

- 2+ years managing Instagram for a brand (e-commerce or DTC preferred).

- Proven experience growing a Threads account. Please show examples.

- Excellent written English and natural storytelling.

- Strong understanding of Reels: hooks, trends, what makes content spread.

- Organized and reliable, comfortable managing a small creative team and a daily publishing schedule.

- Interest in health and wellness is a plus.



Compensation

- Fixed monthly salary: [$300 USD]

- Plus [5-10]% commission on every sale that comes from our organic social media, tracked through dedicated links and discount codes.

- The more your content sells, the more you earn. No cap on commission.



How to apply - Send us:

1. Links to Instagram and Threads accounts you've managed, with the results you achieved.

2. Examples of your work: Reels, Threads posts, Stories, or content calendars you created. Links or a portfolio are fine.

3. Your personal Threads profile, if you have one.

4. Three content ideas for a copper water bottle brand: one Reel, one Threads post, one Story.

5. Your expected monthly salary.



Start your application with the words "COPPER THREADS" so we know you've read the whole post.

title: REAL ESTATE VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS

We are looking for motivated, professional individuals who want to develop real skills working with U.S.-based real estate entrepreneurs.



Selected applicants may be trained to support businesses involved in:

 - Real Estate Wholesaling & Fix and Flip

 - Real Estate Investor Financing

 - Real Estate Notes

 - Residential Real Estate Sales



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may be a good fit if you:

 - Communicate well in English

 - Are comfortable speaking with U.S.-based prospects

 - Can communicate by phone, text,
, and social media

 - Can have a natural conversation without sounding robotic or simply reading a script

 - Are organized, dependable, and able to follow a process

 - Are comfortable learning software and CRM systems

 - Can conduct online research

 - Listen carefully and recognize important information during conversations

 - Are coachable and willing to receive feedback

 - Are comfortable working toward measurable performance goals

   - Previous real estate experience is helpful, but it is NOT required. We will train the right people.



TRAINING

Applicants who successfully complete our interview and selection process will enter the VASO Certified Real Estate Virtual Professional (CREVP) Training Program.



This is a structured 10-business-day training and certification program designed to prepare you to work effectively inside a real estate business.

Successful completion of training and certification is required before assignment to a client.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us the following:

1. Your full name and location

2. Your previous Virtual Assistant experience, if any

3. Any previous real estate experience, if any

4. The hours you are available to work

5. A description of your computer and internet setup

6. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction telling us a little about yourself and why you believe you would make a good Virtual Assistant

7. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation

8. Answer the following question in your own words: 

     - Imagine you are speaking with a potential real estate prospect who says:

       "I'm interested, but I'm really just looking around right now."



What would you say next?



For Question #8, please do not use AI or ChatGPT to create your answer.

There isn't necessarily one perfect answer. We want to see how you listen, think, and communicate naturally.



IMPORTANT



We are selecting only a limited number of applicants for this initial group.

Being selected for an interview does not guarantee certification or client placement.

Applicants must successfully complete the VASO selection, training, and certification process.



If you're looking for an opportunity to develop real-world skills, work with real estate entrepreneurs, and become part of a structured professional VA organization, we'd like to hear from you.



VA SERVICES ONLINE

Get More Done. Build More Business.

People + Systems + Support → Consistent Execution and Results

title: Finance Manager — Xero Accountant for Australian Fashion Wholesale
description:
Finance Manager — Xero Accountant for Australian Fashion Wholesale

Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$450 per week (~US$1,950/month) | Mon–Fri Sydney business hours



Adminworks is recruiting a Finance Manager (Xero Accountant) for an established Australian fashion wholesale and brand-management business.



This role is equal parts phone and spreadsheet. You will own the day-to-day finance function across accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, reconciliations, cash-flow forecasting and management reporting. Just as importantly, you will proactively call customers to collect overdue payments and build strong working relationships with them.



This is not a passive bookkeeping role. If your approach to collections is sending an automated statement and waiting, this role will not suit you.



We need someone comfortable picking up the phone, discussing overdue invoices professionally and persistently, and giving the Directors clear visibility over cash and financial performance.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

Our client is an established Australian fashion wholesale and brand management business representing a portfolio of recognised fashion and lifestyle brands across domestic and international markets, working with a large number of small-business wholesale customers.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Accounts receivable and collections

• Proactively call Australian customers regarding overdue invoices and outstanding information.

• Build genuine customer relationships and understand how individual accounts pay and communicate.

•  Resolve payment discrepancies and follow commitments through to completion.

• Maintain the debtor ledger and accurately allocate payments.

• Chase sales figures and other information needed for commission invoicing.



Finance operations

• Own the day-to-day finance function in Xero.

• Manage accounts payable, receivables and customer invoicing.

• Complete bank, credit-card, debtor, creditor and balance-sheet reconciliations.

• Manage month-end processes and coordinate with external accountants.

 • Maintain accurate, current financial records.



Cash flow and reporting

• Maintain a rolling cash-flow forecast and identify potential issues early.

• Prepare clear weekly and monthly management reports.

• Report on written orders, invoiced sales, cash received, receivables, payables and expenditure.

• Track performance by brand, customer and market.

• Reconcile operational information from order placement through to delivery, invoicing and payment.

• Meet regularly with the Directors and explain financial performance clearly.



Systems and improvement

•  Improve the structure and use of Xero, including accounts, tracking categories and reporting.

• Build practical Excel reporting, reconciliation and cash-flow templates.

• Identify opportunities to improve or automate finance workflows using technology and AI.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• At least five years of accounting, bookkeeping or finance experience.

• Experience owning the end-to-end finance function of a small or medium business.

• Advanced, hands-on Xero experience.

• Demonstrated experience collecting overdue payments by phone.

• Excellent spoken English and a professional, personable phone manner.

•  Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, reconciliations and reporting templates.

• Experience preparing cash-flow forecasts and management reports.

• Confidence presenting financial information to business owners or senior leaders.

• Strong accuracy, organisation and follow-through.

• Reliable internet, backup connectivity and a quiet environment for customer calls.

• Based in the Philippines and available full-time Monday–Friday, Sydney business hours.



HIGHLY REGARDED

• Previous experience supporting an Australian business.

• Familiarity with Australian GST and BAS processes.

• Experience in fashion, wholesale, retail, distribution or another product-based business.

• Experience with commission or agency revenue models.

• Accounting, finance or commerce degree, CPA or equivalent.

• Power Query, Power BI, finance automation or practical AI experience.



ENGAGEMENT & BENEFITS

 • Starting rate US$450 per week (~US$1,950/month).

• Permanent, full-time engagement with a single client — Adminworks handles your onboarding, HR and payroll. Performance review at 6 months.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include all of the following:

1. Your current CV.

2. A short summary of the finance functions you have personally managed in Xero.

3. An example of a difficult overdue account you successfully collected. Tell us how overdue it was, what actions you took and what happened.

4. An example of a cash-flow forecast or management report you have built and regularly maintained.

5. Confirm: Philippines-based, fluent spoken English, full-time Sydney hours at US$450/week.

Please use “FINANCE + PHONE” as the subject of your application.

title: Self-Storage Facility Lead Research VA (Real Estate Deal Sourcing)
description:
About us: Skip Rock Properties is a direct buyer of self-storage facilities -- not a brokerage. We buy off-market, value-add facilities directly from long-time owners, often with seller financing. Most of the facilities we want to buy aren't listed for sale anywhere -- they belong to owners who've run them quietly for decades with no website and no online listing. Finding those owners before anyone else does is the job.



What you'll do:

You'll build out our town-by-town lead list of self-storage facilities across target US states, working from smallest population up. For each town you will:



- Search for every self-storage facility within roughly a 6-8 mile radius of the town center -- not just what shows up on a basic Google Maps search, but everything actually there.

- Do a "flyover" -- visually scan satellite/aerial imagery (Google Maps satellite view, Google Earth) around the town for storage facilities that don't show up in a normal map search at all. These are usually older, family-owned lots with no signage and no online footprint. This is the single most valuable thing you'll do -- we call these "gold leads."

- Estimate the square footage of each facility's buildings from the aerial/satellite view.

- Score each facility's digital presence: Google Business listing (Y/N), website (Y/N), is the website actually functional, can customers pay/reserve online. Weak or no online presence is exactly what we're after -- it signals an owner who isn't actively marketing or managing the business.

- Identify the owner behind each facility using public records -- county appraisal district (property tax) records first, then state Secretary of State / business entity filings, then any other legitimate public source. We need owner name, LLC/entity name if any, mailing address, and ideally phone and
.

- Exclude corporate-owned facilities -- anything owned by a REIT, national/regional storage chain, or investment fund gets flagged and excluded.

- Log everything into our shared spreadsheet in the exact format we use, keeping the list sorted by town population and never overwriting existing rows.



This is ongoing work -- once a state's town list is worked through, we move to the next one.



What we're looking for:

- Sharp with Google Maps, Google Earth, and satellite/aerial imagery -- comfortable spotting a building from above and estimating its size

- Very comfortable in Google Sheets: sorting, formatting, careful data entry, following a strict column structure

- Patient and thorough with public records research (county property records, state business entity searches)

- Self-directed -- you'll get a clear process to follow and should work through it independently, flagging anything unclear rather than guessing

- Strong written English for documenting sources and notes clearly

- Meticulous -- if a piece of data isn't confirmed, mark it unconfirmed, don't leave it blank or make it up



Nice to have: prior experience with real estate lead generation, skip tracing, or VA work for a real estate investor; familiarity with county appraisal district / property tax websites; familiarity with self-storage or commercial real estate.



This is not a sales or cold-calling role -- outreach to owners is handled separately. Your job is finding the facilities and the people behind them, accurately and completely.



To apply: tell us about your experience with online research, Google Maps/Earth, and spreadsheets. If possible, pick any small Texas town and tell us what self-storage facilities you can find there in 30 minutes, including at least one attempt at a "flyover" find.

You will take ownership of weekend callouts, open shifts, schedule changes, and urgent communication. You must be available for the assigned coverage period from **Saturday at 5:00 a.m. to Monday at 6:00 a.m. HST**, including overnight on-call coverage. description:
Company: ModernWorx AI Partners

Work Type: Part-Time / Long-Term Opportunity

Hours: Initially 10–20 hours per week

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Starting Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour based on experience + performance bonuses



About ModernWorx AI



ModernWorx AI Partners helps small and midsize businesses improve the way they operate using AI, automation, and better business systems.



We help companies improve areas such as:



Lead response and follow-up

Missed-call recovery

Appointment scheduling

Customer communication

CRM workflows

Sales follow-up

Review generation

Repetitive administrative processes



Our primary prospects include HVAC, plumbing, home-service companies, and other U.S.-based local businesses.



We are looking for a confident, professional B2B Appointment Setter / Outbound Caller to help us start conversations with business owners and schedule qualified appointments.



What You Will Do



Your primary responsibility is simple:



Start conversations with business owners and schedule qualified appointments.



You will:



Make outbound calls to U.S.-based businesses

Speak with owners, managers, and decision-makers

Introduce ModernWorx AI in a professional and conversational way

Ask basic discovery and qualification questions

Identify potential problems involving lead follow-up, missed calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM processes, and repetitive administrative work

Generate interest in ModernWorx services

Schedule appointments for interested prospects

Update our CRM after every call

Record call results, notes, follow-up dates, and contact information

Make follow-up calls when needed

Follow our calling process and scripts while still sounding natural



You are NOT expected to close the sale or be an AI expert.



Your job is to create interest, qualify the opportunity, and schedule a conversation with the founder.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Speaks excellent, clear, easy-to-understand English

Has a neutral or highly understandable speaking accent for U.S. customers

Sounds natural and confident on the phone

Is comfortable calling U.S. business owners

Does not sound robotic or overly scripted

Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

Can think and respond naturally during conversations

Has strong listening skills

Is organized and dependable

Can accurately update a CRM

Has reliable internet

Has a quality headset and quiet working environment

Can work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Experience



Strong preference will be given to applicants with experience in:



U.S. cold calling

B2B appointment setting

Lead generation

U.S. call centers or BPO environments

Home-service businesses such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, or similar industries

CRM systems

Sales development or SDR work



Previous experience selling AI services is not required.



We will teach you what ModernWorx does and provide clear talking points, scripts, prospect lists, and processes.



Compensation



Starting compensation will generally be:



$4–$6 USD per hour depending on experience



This position will initially be approximately 10–20 hours per week.



There will also be opportunities for performance bonuses for qualified appointments and successful results.



For the right person, this can grow into a larger and longer-term position as ModernWorx grows.



IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required



Because this position involves speaking with U.S. business owners, your spoken communication is extremely important.



Please submit a 60–90 second voice recording with your application.



In your recording, pretend you are calling the owner of an HVAC company in Tampa, Florida.



Introduce yourself and explain that you are calling from ModernWorx AI.



Your goal is simply to get the owner interested enough to have a short conversation about how their company handles leads, missed calls, scheduling, and customer follow-up.



Do not worry about creating the perfect sales pitch.



We want to hear:



Your natural speaking voice

English pronunciation

Confidence

Conversation style

Pacing

Professionalism



Please do not heavily edit the recording.

Please include the following in your application:



Your name

Your hourly rate

How many hours per week you are available

Your experience making calls to U.S. businesses

Your experience with cold calling or appointment setting

Industries you have previously called

CRM systems you have used

Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

Your 60–90 second voice recording

A short explanation of how you handle a prospect who says, “I'm not interested.”



At the beginning of your application, please write:



“I read the entire ModernWorx job post.”



Applications without this sentence and a voice recording may not be considered.



What Success Looks Like



We are not looking for someone who simply makes a large number of calls.



We want someone who can:



Reach the right person → Have a real conversation → Identify a potential need → Create interest → Book a qualified appointment.



Quality matters more than blindly dialing hundreds of numbers.



If you are dependable, communicate well, enjoy talking with business owners, and want an opportunity to grow with a U.S.-based AI and automation company, we would like to hear from you.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE (DO NOT APPLY PLEASE IF YOU DON'T HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH COMMSLAYER MOST BE VERY GOOD AT IT. THANKS FOR UNDERSTANDING



Starting Salary: $600 USD/month



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance





ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist who has worked directly with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands.



This is NOT a general customer service position.



We are NOT looking for someone who has only worked in call centers, restaurants, hotels, telecommunications, or other types of customer service.



You must already have real experience working inside Shopify stores and handling the specific type of customer service described below.



You must have a minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience.



If you do not have experience with these exact requirements, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have hands-on experience with:



• Shopify stores

• Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Gmail

• Returns and refunds directly inside Shopify

• Shopify order management

• Shopify order notes

• Unfulfilled orders

• Tracking numbers

• Tracking synchronization issues

• Working with sourcing agents for orders problematics 

• Customer complaints

• Refund requests by customers 

• Replacement requests by customers 

• Chargebacks

• Commslayer app (IS A MOST)





COMMSLAYER EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have hands-on experience using Commslayer.



You need to understand how the app works and how to properly organize customer conversations inside the system.



You should understand the different functionalities available inside Commslayer, including its AI capabilities.



You must already know how to use the system efficiently.



If you have never worked with Commslayer, DO NOT APPLY.



We are looking for someone who already knows the software and can start working without basic training.





SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already know how to work directly inside Shopify.



You should be comfortable handling situations such as:



• Customer requests a refund

• Customer requests a replacement

• Customer says an order has not arrived

• Order is showing as unfulfilled

• Tracking number is missing

• Tracking number did not synchronize from the sourcing agent

• Tracking information is incorrect

• Customer received the wrong product

• Customer received the wrong size or color

• Product is damaged

• Customer wants to return a product

• Customer claims they never received the package



You should already understand what actions need to be taken inside Shopify and how to document important changes using order notes.





CUSTOMER SERVICE + COMPANY FINANCIALS



This is extremely important.



We do NOT want someone who simply gives the customer whatever they ask for.



We want someone who understands how to make the customer happy while also protecting the company's money.



You need to understand that every refund, replacement, reshipment, discount, and customer-service decision has a financial impact on the company.



You should understand:



• Refund rates

• Chargeback rates

• The financial impact of excessive refunds

• The financial impact of unnecessary replacements

• How to handle difficult customers without unnecessarily losing money

• When it makes sense to refund

• When it makes sense to replace

• When another solution is better

• How to protect the company's interests while still providing excellent customer service



The goal is not to say YES to every customer.



The goal is to find the right solution for the customer while protecting the company.





HUMAN CUSTOMER SERVICE



We do NOT want robotic customer service.



You need to understand the situation before responding.



Customers should feel that they are speaking with a real person who understands their problem.



You need to know how to:



• Listen

• Understand the real problem

• Communicate clearly

• Show empathy

• Solve problems quickly

• Keep customers satisfied

• Stay professional with difficult customers

• Protect the company at the same time



You should be able to make good decisions instead of simply following scripts.





ORGANIZATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You must be extremely organized.



You will be dealing with a large number of customer conversations, orders, refunds, returns, replacements, tracking issues, and other problems.



You need to know how to keep everything organized and make sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should naturally be someone who:



• Keeps track of open problems

• Follows up when necessary

• Documents important information

• Adds Shopify order notes when changes happen

• Keeps conversations organized

• Does not lose track of customers

• Does not need to be constantly reminded what to do

• Takes initiative when something needs to be solved





INITIATIVE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We want someone who sees a problem and takes action.



If you notice an order has been unfulfilled because the tracking number from the sourcing agent did not synchronize, you should already know what to investigate and what steps to take.



You should not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



We want someone who thinks ahead, solves problems, and takes ownership of their work.





SPEED + ACCURACY



We work with a high volume of customer requests.



You need to work quickly without becoming careless.



We want someone who can handle a large workload while maintaining:



• Accuracy

• Organization

• Good communication

• Good judgment

• Fast response times



You should not work like a robot just trying to close tickets.



You need to understand what is happening and make the correct decision.





LEARNING FROM MISTAKES



Nobody is perfect.



Mistakes can happen.



What matters is that you learn from them.



If you make a mistake, you need to understand why it happened, correct it, and make sure you do not keep making the same mistake.



We want someone who improves over time and takes responsibility for their work.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



• Has 3–5+ years of highly relevant experience

• Has worked specifically with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Has hands-on Shopify experience

• Has Commslayer experience

• Has Gmail experience

• Understands returns and refunds

• Understands chargebacks

• Understands Shopify order management

• Understands tracking and fulfillment problems

• Understands how sourcing-agent tracking works

• Is extremely organized

• Has strong initiative

• Works fast

• Speaks and writes very good English

• Provides human customer service

• Understands customer psychology and expectations

• Understands how to protect company finances

• Takes ownership

• Learns from mistakes

• Wants to grow with the company long term

• Has genuine passion for customer service





DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have less than 3 years of relevant experience

• You have never worked directly with Shopify stores

• You have only worked in general customer service

• You have worked mainly in call centers

• You have no Shopify apparel/e-commerce experience

• You have never used Commslayer

• You do not understand Shopify returns and refunds

• You have never handled Shopify orders directly

• You have never dealt with fulfillment/tracking issues

• You are not extremely organized

• You need constant supervision

• You do not understand the financial impact of refunds and replacements

• You simply give customers whatever they ask for

• You provide robotic/scripted customer service

• You are slow

• You do not take initiative

• You repeatedly make the same mistakes

• You are looking for a short-term position



PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE REAL, HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE WITH THE SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS ABOVE.

Philippines Accounting & BIR



You should have practical experience with Philippine accounting and BIR requirements, including:

* VAT and withholding taxes

* Tax filing schedules

* Books of accounts

* Invoice compliance

* Payroll-related accounting

* BIR documentation

* Preparing accounting information for annual filings

Invoice Management



You will help control our invoicing process, including:



* Preparing customer invoices

* Checking invoice accuracy

* Recording customer payments

* Monitoring unpaid invoices

* Following up outstanding accounts

* Matching invoices with quotations and purchase orders

* Maintaining proper documentation



Quotation Management



You will also assist management and the sales team with quotation control.



You should be able to check:



* Supplier cost

* Freight

* Currency conversion

* GST/VAT where applicable

* Bank and transfer fees

* Customer deposits

* Payment terms

* Gross profit

* Gross margin

* Quote validity

* Supplier-payment requirements



We want someone who understands that good accounting is not only about recording transactions after they happen. You should also help us understand the financial position of a transaction before we proceed.



SALS3 Accounting



You will also assist with:



* E-commerce sales reconciliation

* Customer payments

* Refunds

* Supplier costs

* Payment gateway transactions

* Marketing expenses

* Transaction fees

* Gross-profit tracking



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:



* At least 3–5 years accounting experience

* Strong Xero experience

* Good BIR knowledge

* Strong bank reconciliation skills

* Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable experience

* Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Experience with foreign-currency transactions

* Good written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* High integrity and confidentiality

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to communicate clearly with management



CPA qualification is an advantage but is not essential if you have strong practical accounting experience.



Experience supporting an Australian business, e-commerce, importing, logistics or international trading will be an advantage.



Salary



₱40,000–₱50,000 per month depending on experience and capability.



This is a long-term position with the opportunity to grow as Anything Supplies and SALS3 expand.

title: Part-Time U.S. Bookkeeper / US Tax Preparer – QuickBooks Online
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based tax and accounting firm looking for an experienced **Bookkeeper / US Tax Preparer** in the Philippines to join our team long-term.



This is primarily a bookkeeping position. During tax season, we would also like this person to assist our tax team with preparation of U.S. individual and business tax returns.



We are looking for someone who already has experience working with U.S. accounting or tax firms and can work independently without extensive training.



**Schedule and Pay**



Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with the potential to grow into a full-time position for the right person as our firm grows. Hours may also increase during U.S. tax season.



$12–$15 USD per hour depending on experience.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term position with our firm.



Some overlap with U.S. Mountain Time business hours will be needed for team communication,



**Bookkeeping Responsibilities**



You will manage bookkeeping for multiple U.S. small-business clients using QuickBooks Online.



Your work will include categorizing transactions, reconciling bank and credit card accounts, reviewing balance-sheet accounts, preparing and reviewing monthly profit-and-loss and balance-sheet reports, recording payroll and other journal entries, cleaning up existing books, researching discrepancies, and identifying items that need additional client information.



We want someone who understands accounting, not someone who simply categorizes transactions from the bank feed.



You should be comfortable taking responsibility for a client's books from beginning to month-end completion.



**Tax Preparation Responsibilities**



During tax season, you will assist our tax team with U.S. tax return preparation.



Experience preparing Forms 1040, 1120-S and 1065 is strongly preferred.



You may receive a client's prior-year return, current-year tax documents and completed bookkeeping and be expected to prepare as much of the return as possible before sending it to our U.S. tax team for review.



Experience with business returns, rental properties, Schedule C businesses, K-1s and real estate clients is a major plus.



We currently use ProSeries for tax preparation. Experience with ProSeries is preferred, but experience with Drake, Lacerte, ProConnect, UltraTax or similar U.S. tax software is acceptable.



**What We Are Looking For**



You should have at least 5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience and substantial experience with QuickBooks Online.



Experience working directly with U.S. businesses or U.S. accounting firms is required.



Previous U.S. tax preparation experience is strongly preferred. We are particularly interested in candidates who have actually prepared U.S. tax returns rather than only organizing documents or performing data entry.



You should understand bank and credit-card reconciliations, general ledger accounting, adjusting journal entries, balance-sheet reconciliations and month-end bookkeeping.



Strong written English and communication skills are important.



You should also be comfortable researching an accounting issue, identifying something that does not make sense and asking questions rather than simply completing a task incorrectly.



Experience with TaxDome is a plus.



**How to Apply**



Please use the subject line ELITE BOOKKEEPER.



In your application, please briefly answer the following:



How many years have you worked with U.S. bookkeeping or accounting clients?



How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?



Which U.S. tax returns have you prepared? Please specify 1040, 1120-S, 1065, or others.



Which U.S. tax preparation software have you used?



What hourly rate are you requesting?



Are you available to consistently work Monday through Friday during U.S. Mountain Time business hours?



Please include a copy or link to your résumé.

title: Experienced Accountant for Growing Canadian CPA Firm
description:
Job Title: Full-Time Bookkeeper & Accounting Associate (Remote)



Company: Modern Axis CPA

Type: Part-Time to start, Full-Time in 3 months, Permanent

Reports To: Alex Ataman, CPA (Owner)



About Modern Axis CPA



We are a modern, tech-forward CPA firm based in Victoria, BC, specializing in small-to-medium business tax and personal cross-border taxation. We believe in leveraging technology to streamline accounting processes, allowing us to focus on high-value advisory and strategic support for our clients.



We are inviting a dedicated, tech-savvy professional to join our team full-time. This role is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys bookkeeping but is also curious about the broader accounting picture. You will start by mastering our bookkeeping workflow and, over time, have the chance to expand your skills into tax preparation and higher-level accounting tasks.



The Role



You will play an integral role in our daily operations, working closely with the firm owner. Your primary focus will be managing full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online for a diverse portfolio of clients, ensuring their financial data is accurate and up-to-date.



While this is primarily a bookkeeping role, we are looking for someone who wants to understand the "why" behind the numbers. If you have some familiarity with Canadian tax (T1/T2), that’s wonderful—but if not, we are happy to help you grow into that area. We value problem-solvers who thrive in a supportive, digital-first environment.



Key Responsibilities



Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Manage day-to-day bookkeeping for a dedicated client portfolio using QuickBooks Online (QBO).



Reconciliation & Review: Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations, ensuring transactions are accurately coded.



Compliance & Filing: Prepare and file GST/PST/HST returns and assist with payroll compliance.



Quality Control: Help us spot discrepancies or missing documentation early on to keep year-end files clean and stress-free.



Process Efficiency: Use our tech stack (TaxDome, QBO, Dext) to keep workflows organized and efficient.



Team Support: Collaborate with the firm owner on year-end working papers and tax return preparation as your skills develop.



Qualifications



Required:



Experience: 4+ years of full-cycle Canadian bookkeeping experience, preferably within a public practice or multi-client environment.



Tax Knowledge: Understanding of GST. Other Canadian tax concepts (T1 Personal or T2 Corporate returns) is a definite asset, though not required.



Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online is essential for this role.



Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage your time effectively in a remote setting.



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Preferred (Nice to Have):



Tech Stack: Dext (for receipt capture) is a big plus.



Cross-Border: Familiarity with USD/CAD transactions.



Education: Bookkeeping certification (CPB) or an accounting diploma.



Why Join Us?



Career Progression: We support your professional growth, offering mentorship from a CPA and the chance to learn tax and advisory skills.



Remote-First Culture: Work comfortably from anywhere in Canada with a fully digital, paperless workflow.



Stable & Long-Term: This is a permanent, full-time position with a growing firm that values long-term relationships.



Tech-Forward: We use modern tools to automate repetitive tasks, so you can focus on the work that matters.



Compensation & Details



Schedule: Flexible. You are not expected to work full-time in the Canadian time zone. However, some overlap with Pacific Standard Time (PST) will be needed for collaboration. Compensation heavily depends on skills and experience. 



To Apply:

Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:



Explain your exposure to Canadian bookkeeping and tax.



Explain your experience with Dext.



Explain your experience with Canadian Payroll.

title: Operations & Implementation Manager
description:
Operations & Implementation Manager — Entrepreneur’s Right Hand



Remote | Full-Time



I’m an entrepreneur and creative producer involved in several businesses and projects, and I’m looking for a highly organized, systems-minded person to work directly alongside me as my operational right hand.



Why I’m Hiring



In most of my businesses and projects, I play a similar role.



I typically partner with people who bring specialized technical expertise. My partners may understand the technology, creative discipline, service, or technical side of the business better than I do.



My job is to bring the pieces together.



I help turn that expertise into a product or service we can actually sell. I package the offering, develop the business model, build partnerships, find opportunities, sell, market, raise or allocate money, and help determine how the organization should operate.



I’m strongest when I’m talking to people, solving problems, developing opportunities, making deals, selling, marketing, and figuring out how all the pieces should fit together.



The problem comes after the meeting.



We can sit in a meeting, identify the problem, make decisions, determine the solution, and leave knowing exactly what should happen next.



But then I’m back to selling, meeting people, developing the next opportunity, and running several organizations at once.



I don’t currently have enough infrastructure on my side to consistently carry those solutions through implementation.



Things that should take a week can take a month. Projects sit on lists. Systems we’ve already d
 to build don’t get built quickly enough.



That’s the bottleneck I’m hiring this person to solve.



Your Role



I’m looking for someone who can come alongside me while I’m developing deals, generating revenue, building partnerships, packaging products, and determining how we want the business to operate.



Once we’ve established the framework, you help turn it into reality.



The relationship should increasingly work like this:



I create the opportunity → We define the solution → You organize implementation → The right people/AI/software execute → You manage follow-through → I step back in when my judgment, relationship, sales ability, or approval is needed.



You’re not simply completing tasks I assign.



You’re helping me build the team, systems, technology, processes, and infrastructure that allow me and my business partners to accomplish more and make more money.



What Implementation Might Look Like



There won’t be one solution for everything.



For one project, we might build a specialized AI assistant.



For another, you might research and implement software.



For another, we might d
 that AI isn’t the right answer at all and hire a freelancer, contractor, or employee.



You might also:



* Build a spreadsheet, database, dashboard, or tracking system

* Turn meeting decisions into projects, tasks, owners, budgets, and deadlines

* Research vendors and request quotes

* Interview or coordinate freelancers

* Build workflows for existing team members

* Document processes and create SOPs

* Track budgets, costs, revenue, and performance data

* Follow up with partners, employees, customers, and vendors

* Manage projects through completion

* Identify repetitive work that should be automated or delegated

* Research new technology and determine whether it’s actually useful

* Create systems so successful projects can operate without constant involvement from me



The goal is not to use AI everywhere.



The goal is to determine the smartest way to get something done.



Sometimes that’s AI. Sometimes it’s software. Sometimes it’s an existing employee. Sometimes we need to hire somebody.



You should be able to help make that distinction.



AI & Technology



You should have a strong practical understanding of modern AI tools.



You don’t need to be an AI engineer, but you should understand what current AI systems are good at, what they’re bad at, and how to use them effectively for research, organization, analysis, documentation, communication, and business operations.



I’d like us to gradually build AI systems that understand our businesses and multiply what you and the rest of the team can accomplish.



At the same time, I specifically do not want someone who thinks AI is automatically the answer to every problem.



Good judgment matters more.



Systems, Numbers & Organization



If I had to choose between someone who is primarily creative and someone who is primarily systems- and numbers-oriented, I would choose the systems person.



You should enjoy taking something messy and creating structure around it.



You should be comfortable with spreadsheets, budgets, data, timelines, databases, project-management systems, costs, basic financial analysis, and keeping large amounts of information organized.



You should naturally want to know:



What are we trying to accomplish?

What needs to happen next?

Who owns it?

What will it cost?

When is it due?

How are we tracking it?

What’s holding it up?

How do we prevent this problem from happening again?



Creativity is still extremely valuable. The ideal person understands that businesses and creative projects aren’t always neat or predictable and can think creatively when designing a solution.



But your primary instinct should be systems and execution.



Communication



Strong spoken and written English is important.



Although this is a remote position, you won’t spend your entire day behind a computer.



As trust develops, I need to be able to say:



“Can you call them and figure this out?”



You should be comfortable professionally communicating with customers, vendors, contractors, employees, business partners, and potential hires by
, phone, or video call when appropriate.



The Businesses



You’ll initially work across four businesses/projects:



Peachy Greens Gardening — An established gardening company with an employee and existing customers.



Still Kicking Mobility — An elder mobility startup being developed with business partners who bring specialized expertise.



Creative Media — Social and video content surrounding our businesses, theatre, creatives, and interesting people.



Theatre Producing — Freelance theatrical producing and development, including story, spectacle, research, pitching, and new project development.



The industries are different, but my role within them is remarkably similar—which is why I want one person working alongside me across all of them.



Who I’m Looking For



I’m looking for someone who is:



* Exceptionally organized and systems-minded

* Strong with numbers, spreadsheets, and data

* Comfortable with AI and emerging technology

* A strong researcher and problem solver

* Excellent at project management and follow-through

* Comfortable coordinating other people

* Able to communicate professionally by phone, video, and writing

* Capable of turning messy conversations and ideas into concrete action plans

* Comfortable hiring and managing freelancers or vendors

* Good at documenting processes

* Persistent about getting things across the finish line

* Able to work across several very different industries

* Comfortable saying when an idea doesn’t make operational or financial sense

* Creative enough to find unconventional solutions when necessary



You don’t need to know how to personally perform every task.



You need to be good at figuring out how we’re going to get the task accomplished and then making sure it actually happens.



What Success Looks Like



Six months into working together, I want you to understand how I operate well enough that we can leave a meeting having made ten decisions and I don’t have to personally carry those ten decisions around in my head afterward.



You capture them.



You turn them into projects.



You determine what can be handled by AI, what can be handled by our existing team, what requires outside help, and what still requires me.



You keep everything moving.



Then you bring me back in at the points where I’m most valuable—making decisions, developing relationships, selling, negotiating, creating opportunities, solving higher-level problems, and shaping the product.



I don’t need someone to simply keep me organized.



I need someone who helps turn decisions into execution and helps me build the infrastructure that allows my partners, businesses, and ideas to reach their full potential.

title: Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor
description:
Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor



We’re looking for a driven Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor who wants to grow with our team long-term.



Your main responsibility will be editing and polishing podcast content, but we’re not looking for someone who only knows how to cut clips together. This role is built for an editor who wants to seriously improve their craft and eventually take full ownership of projects.



You’ll work alongside experienced editors and creatives while developing your skills in YouTube editing, storytelling, pacing, VFX, motion graphics, sound design, and creative decision-making.



You don’t need to be an expert yet, but you should already have a strong foundation in editing and understand the fundamentals of text animation, rotoscoping or rotobrushing, audio balancing, sound effects, color correction, and motion graphics.



We’ll provide feedback, guidance, and mentorship, but our goal is to help you become a highly capable, independent editor who can eventually produce excellent work without needing constant supervision.



If you already have the fundamentals and are serious about becoming an exceptional editor, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Edit, clean, and polish approximately one podcast episode per week into a professional, high-quality final video.



Maintain a very high level of quality control throughout every project. Catch issues such as bad cuts, awkward pauses, syncing problems, spelling mistakes, audio inconsistencies, or sloppy frames before delivery.



Create animated intros, text overlays, visual callouts, motion graphics, and sound effects that improve the viewing experience.



Clean and balance dialogue, music, and sound effects so the final mix sounds professional.



Perform basic color correction and grading to maintain a clean and consistent look.



Work with senior editors and creatives to improve your storytelling, pacing, VFX, and YouTube editing skills.



Apply feedback quickly and accurately during revision rounds.



Gradually take more ownership of projects until you’re capable of managing the editing process independently.



What We’re Looking For



Fundamental to intermediate proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.



A solid understanding of audio mixing, dialogue balancing, music levels, and basic sound design.



Basic knowledge of color correction and grading.



Experience with fundamental motion graphics, text animation, rotobrushing or rotoscoping, and simple visual effects.



Strong attention to detail. Small mistakes should bother you.



A portfolio that demonstrates clean editing, solid pacing, good audio work, and basic motion graphics.



A genuine desire to improve your skills and become significantly better at editing.



Someone who actively studies great editors, creators, videos, and storytelling techniques.



Ability to receive feedback without ego and implement changes quickly.



Strong communication and organizational skills.



Ability to consistently deliver approximately one polished episode per week without sacrificing quality.



Self-motivated and capable of becoming increasingly independent over time.



Our Quality Standard



These videos represent the level of quality and polish we’re working toward.



Please watch them before applying so you have a clear understanding of the standard expected for this role:















You don’t need to already be capable of producing this exact level of work, but you should be willing and able to grow toward it.



Bonus Points



Experience editing educational, entrepreneurial, business, or personal brand content.



Experience working with creators, entrepreneurs, agencies, or online businesses.



A good understanding of how YouTube editing differs from traditional video editing.



Experience improving pacing, retention, hooks, storytelling, and viewer engagement.



Experience building efficient editing workflows or production systems.



Experience using 
, ClickUp, or similar project management and review tools.



Compensation



$150 to $250 per video, depending on your skill level and the quality of your work.



Editors who demonstrate strong attention to detail, creative judgment, reliability, editing speed, and the ability to work independently will be considered toward the higher end of the range.



Please include your preferred rate per video when applying.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who wants more than just another editing gig.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become extremely good at what they do.



Someone who wants to improve their storytelling, creative judgment, technical ability, and understanding of YouTube.



Over time, we want you to be able to take ownership of projects, make strong creative decisions without being told exactly what to do, and consistently produce content that feels polished, engaging, and world-class.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller – Full Time, US Market ($3/hr + Bonus)
description:
We are a small real estate investment company in Oklahoma City and Kansas City. We buy houses directly from homeowners, including inherited properties, rentals, and houses with back taxes or liens.



We're building a calling team. You will call homeowners from targeted lists in our CRM, find the ones who want to sell, and book them a call with our acquisitions manager. Some calls are fast and high volume. Some are with families who recently lost someone and need patience. Tell us which kind of call you're best at.



PAY: $3/hour base, 40 hours/week, US Central Time business hours, PLUS a $50 bonus for every appointment you set that turns into a signed contract (paid on the next payroll). No cap.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make 150+ outbound dials a day from our CRM (DataSift) using smrtPhone or smrtDialer

- Follow our 3-day sequential calling cadence on every record

- Send the follow-up text after every voi

- Confirm you're speaking with the owner or the right family member

- Ask about condition, timeline, motivation and price

- Book motivated sellers onto our acquisitions manager's calendar the same day

- Log every call with the correct disposition



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear English and a friendly, confident voice

- Stable wired internet, a backup connection, a USB headset and a quiet room

- Available for the full shift, Monday to Friday

- Hits daily numbers without being chased



NICE TO HAVE: DataSift/REISift, smrtPhone, or power dialer experience; probate or inherited-property calling.



TO APPLY: Use the subject line "RAPID CALLER". Include your years of experience, your best daily dial and appointment numbers, the dialers and CRMs you've used, whether you're better at high-volume or sensitive calls, and a 60-second voice recording of you reading this with camera onm :



"Hi, is this Mike? Hey Mike, this is [your name] with Home Buyers. I'm calling about 1420 Oak Street. Would you consider an offer on it if the number made sense?"



Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

.

Accountabilities:

The Key Account Manager is specifically accountable for the following measurable objectives within their assigned client portfolio:

* Client Partnership: Holding relationships with key decision-makers within assigned client accounts, positioning itGenius as a trusted technology partner.



* Client Retention & Satisfaction: Accountable for maintaining high levels of client satisfaction and ensuring the retention of assigned client accounts.



* Revenue Growth: Accountable for identifying and securing opportunities for revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell within their assigned client portfolio.

title: Transaction Coordinator
description:
# Experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator — Virtual



**Full-Time | Experienced Candidates Only**

 high-producing New Jersey real estate team completing approximately **100 transactions annually** and continuing to grow.



We are seeking an **experienced Real Estate Transaction Coordinator** to take ownership of our transactions from **contract preparation through closing**.



This is not an entry-level VA or general administrative role. We are specifically seeking someone with previous **U.S. residential real estate transaction experience** who understands deadlines, documents, client communication and the moving pieces required to get a transaction successfully to the closing table.



### Responsibilities



* Prepare contracts and transaction documents as directed by licensed agents

* Create and maintain complete transaction files

* Coordinate transactions from accepted offer through closing

* Track attorney review, deposits, inspections, appraisal, mortgage commitment, title and closing deadlines

* Coordinate inspections, appraisals, walkthroughs and transaction-related appointments

* Communicate with attorneys, lenders, title companies, cooperating agents, inspectors and vendors

* Track inspection items, repair requests, credits and outstanding documentation

* Coordinate CO, smoke/fire certifications and applicable municipal requirements

* Prepare commission paperwork and closing documentation

* Maintain compliance checklists and ensure required documents are complete

* Keep agents and team members updated on transaction status

* Identify potential problems and approaching deadlines before they become emergencies

* Proactively follow up when information, signatures or documentation are outstanding

* Maintain accurate transaction records from contract through closing

* Provide professional client updates, primarily through **text and
**

* Answer routine transaction questions while appropriately escalating negotiations, legal questions and sensitive client matters to the agent



### Who We're Looking For



We want someone who has **already done this job successfully.**



You should understand the U.S. residential real estate transaction process and be comfortable managing a high-volume pipeline with multiple transactions moving simultaneously.



You are highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive and an excellent communicator. You don't wait to be told something is late—you already know it's due and have followed up.



Most importantly, you **take ownership of the transaction.**



When an agent hands you a contract, they should be able to return their attention to selling real estate knowing that you are managing the details, communication and deadlines necessary to get that client to closing.



### Experience & Qualifications



* **2+ years of U.S. residential real estate transaction coordination experience strongly preferred**

* Experience supporting a high-volume residential real estate team

* Strong understanding of the contract-to-close process

* Experience preparing real estate contracts and transaction documents under agent/broker direction

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable communicating directly with clients

* Exceptional organization, follow-up and deadline management

* Experience communicating with attorneys, lenders, title companies and cooperating agents

* **New Jersey real estate transaction experience is a major plus**



### Technology Experience — Strongly Preferred



Candidates with hands-on experience using the following will be strongly preferred:



* **Follow Up Boss**

* **BoldTrail**

* **Google Workspace** — Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Calendar

* Electronic signature and transaction-management platforms



We are looking for someone who is already comfortable working inside a technology-driven real estate team and can quickly learn our existing systems and workflows.



### About the Team



 a high-volume New Jersey real estate team completing approximately **100 transactions per year**, with continued growth ahead.



We operate at a high standard and place a strong emphasis on responsiveness, professionalism and client experience.



We're looking for a Transaction Coordinator who can become the **steady hand behind every deal**—organized, proactive, accountable and several steps ahead.

title: Experienced Animator & Visual Storyteller | Cartoons, Animated Films & Original Stories
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on creative who can help turn original ideas into cartoons, animated short films, and engaging visual stories.



We want someone we can talk with about characters, story ideas, animation styles, and the practical process of bringing a project to life. You should be able to contribute creatively, explain how you work, and help us understand what is achievable at different levels of production, budget, and time.



This is not simply a video-editing role or an AI-prompting role. We are looking for genuine animation and storytelling ability, supported by examples of work you have personally created.



YOUR ANIMATION SKILLS MUST STAND ON THEIR OWN



You must be able to create animation without relying on generative AI. Digital animation software is absolutely welcome; “without AI” does not mean everything must be drawn on paper.



We expect AI to become part of our workflow where it genuinely helps. However, we want someone who understands the underlying craft and can make deliberate creative decisions, maintain character consistency, solve animation problems, and refine scenes rather than depend entirely on generated results.



If your experience consists only of generating AI images or clips and joining them together, this is not the right role.



WHAT YOU COULD HELP US CREATE



- Cartoons and animated stories: Character-led scenes, short episodes, and original animated content.

- Animated short films: Stories with a clear beginning, middle, and end, including dialogue, emotion, humour, and action where appropriate.

- Story development: Turning rough ideas into concepts, scripts, storyboards, and animatics.

- Characters and visual worlds: Developing or adapting a consistent look, personality, movement style, and setting.

- Finished productions: Bringing animation, voices, music, sound, and editing together into a coherent final piece.



You do not need to be an expert in every discipline or in both 2D and 3D. Tell us where you are strongest, what you can produce independently, and where you would collaborate with others.



WHO WE WOULD LIKE TO HEAR FROM



- Proven animators: A portfolio of completed cartoons, animated scenes, or films, with a clear explanation of your contribution.

- Strong storytellers: An understanding of character, pacing, staging, performance, and visual storytelling.

- Practical creators: The ability to take work beyond a concept and deliver usable, finished animation.

- Thoughtful collaborators: Someone comfortable discussing ideas, proposing approaches, receiving feedback, and explaining trade-offs.

- Organised professionals: Clear communication about milestones, revisions, realistic timelines, and project files.

- Open-minded tool users: Willingness to explore AI-assisted methods without replacing core creative and technical skills.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Links to two or three relevant animation or film projects. At least one must demonstrate animation you created without generative AI.

2. Your exact contribution to each example, including whether it was individual or team work. Clearly identify any AI-generated elements.

3. Your strongest areas: 2D animation, 3D animation, character design, storyboarding, writing, directing, editing, or another relevant specialty.

4. The software you use and a short explanation of your process from story idea to finished animation.

5. What you could produce yourself versus what would require additional specialists.

6. Your availability, preferred working arrangement, and expected rate.



For shortlisted applicants, we would like an initial conversation about your portfolio, creative process, and how you would approach an original cartoon or animated short. Please be prepared to walk us through an existing project and explain the decisions behind it; no new animation is required for your initial application.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT AND COMPENSATION



The working arrangement, hours, and compensation will be discussed based on your experience, availability, and the agreed project scope. We are interested in finding the right creative collaborator, with the potential for ongoing work.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment & Staffing 

* Lead recruitment efforts for nanny and household staffing positions nationwide.

* Write compelling, accurate job descriptions tailored to each family’s needs.

* Source qualified candidates through job boards, social media, networking, and local outreach.

* Review resumes, conduct initial interviews, and assess candidates for experience, professionalism, and overall fit.

* Coordinate and complete background-screening processes, including social media, employment, education, and certification verification.

* Conduct detailed reference checks with former employers rather than personal references.

* Create, maintain, and organize candidate profiles.

* Track candidates throughout every stage of the recruitment process using Trello, Dubsado, and NannyLogic.

* Develop recruiting KPIs, monitor performance metrics, and prepare weekly Excel reports.

* Proactively follow up with candidates and ensure the recruitment pipeline continues moving forward.

* Ensure candidates meet agency standards and align with each family’s preferences and needs.

* Identify gaps or inefficiencies in our recruitment process and recommend practical improvements.



Nanny Relationship Management

* Build and nurture strong relationships with current and prospective nannies.

* Serve as the first point of contact for candidate questions, feedback, and support.

* Follow up consistently and ensure candidates feel informed throughout the process.

* Communicate with warmth and professionalism while reflecting the values of The Nanny Edit.

* Help create a positive candidate experience from the initial application through placement.



Executive & Administrative Support

* Serve as a dependable right hand to the agency owner.

* Manage competing priorities and ensure important tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups are completed.

* Organize and update internal databases, spreadsheets, and client and candidate documentation.

* Create and maintain tracking sheets, reports, checklists, and organized workflows in Excel and Google Sheets.

* Support scheduling and internal projects through Trello and Google Workspace.

* Assist with research, outreach, business development, blog writing, partnerships, and other special projects.

* Be willing to jump into unexpected or last-minute assignments when needed.

* Anticipate needs, identify potential problems, and take initiative without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

* Recommend new systems, tools, or processes that could improve efficiency and organization.



Social Media & Branding

* Help develop and implement engaging social media strategies across multiple platforms.

* Write and schedule educational, engaging, and exciting content that reflects our values.

* Monitor and respond to comments and messages with professionalism and warmth.

* Maintain consistency across all written and visual content.

* Help brainstorm creative marketing ideas, partnerships, and opportunities for brand growth.



 Learning, Technology & Innovation

* Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve productivity, organization, content creation, and recruiting processes.

* Stay open to learning new platforms, systems, and strategies.

* Complete paid courses or training when requested to develop skills that will benefit the agency.

* Research emerging tools and recommend practical ways to incorporate them into our workflow.

* Look for faster, smarter, and more organized ways to complete recurring tasks.



Qualifications

* At least five years of recruiting experience, preferably within the nanny, household staffing, or broader staffing industry.

* Previous experience as an Executive Virtual Assistant or in a similar administrative role.

* Strong working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, Canva, Trello, Calendly, and Google Workspace.

* Demonstrated ability to create, track, analyze, and report KPIs.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Strong relationship-building and candidate-management abilities.

* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and shifting priorities in a remote environment.

* Comfortable using AI tools and excited to continue learning.

* Able to work independently, make sound decisions, and take ownership of responsibilities.

* Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential family, candidate, and business information.
